item.title: Harris ripped over video previewing Trump speech she claims she wouldn't watch: 'Sit this one out'
item.summary: Former VP kamala Harris drew sharp conservative backlash after posting a video on X criticizing Trump's Iran address, claiming he started a war nobody wants.

item.title: Arizona girl last seen walking to stable before vanishing found alive decades later, authorities say
item.summary: Christina Plante, who vanished from Star Valley, Arizona, at age 13 in 1994, has been found alive after 32 years, closing a decades-old cold case.

item.title: Artemis II launch steals the show at college softball game as players stare skyward in amazement
item.summary: NASA's Artemis II moon rocket stole the show at a Florida Gators-Stetson softball game as players paused in awe during the historic lunar launch.

item.title: Airline cracks down on crew's weight, fitness and health, warning some staff could be pulled from flights
item.summary: Cabin crew at Air India could face unpaid leave under a new health and fitness policy, with those classified as obese via BMI removed from flight rosters, according to reports.

item.title: NJ lawmaker warns adults behaved 'badly' with missing Newark COVID funds meant for kids
item.summary: NJ lawmakers seek a federal probe into Newark Public Schools, alleging $287 million in COVID relief funds were mismanaged and students denied tutoring.

item.title: Churches turn to drones, skydiving bunnies for Easter outreach
item.summary: Churches across America are celebrating Easter with helicopter egg drops, skydiving bunnies and drone shows to draw families and communities together.

item.title: NY House GOP launches pressure campaign on Hochul to scrap climate law over soaring energy costs
item.summary: New York GOP lawmakers are pressuring Gov. Kathy Hochul to repeal the state's climate law, citing rising energy costs and an affordability crisis.

item.title: Alabama ABC affiliate apologizes after anchor signed off by quoting terror-linked Muslim Brotherhood founder
item.summary: An ABC affiliate in Alabama apologized on Monday after an anchor ended a newscast by quoting the founder of the Muslim Brotherhood.

item.title: Ricky Saints hopes to add to his accolades with NXT Championship victory at Stand & Deliver
item.summary: Ricky Saints will compete in a fatal four-way match for the NXT championship against current champion Joe Hendry, Tony D'Angelo and Ethan Page.

item.title: Florida Democratic Party vice chair’s husband charged with murder after she was found dead at home
item.summary: Florida Democratic Party vice chair and Coral Springs Vice Mayor Nancy Bowen's husband is accused of premeditated murder and evidence tampering.
